units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, goodbye, thank you and sorry.

units.title: Numbers 0–10
units.description: Count from zero to ten and say yes, no and good.

units.title: About me
units.description: Say who you are, your name and where you are from.

units.title: Family
units.description: Talk about mum, dad, brothers, sisters and who you have.

units.title: Bigger numbers & age
units.description: Numbers up to one hundred, and asking how old someone is.

units.title: Food & drink
units.description: Rice, noodles, tea and coffee: say what you eat and drink.

units.title: Eating out
units.description: Order at a hawker centre or restaurant and ask for the bill.

units.title: Shopping & money
units.description: Ask prices, bargain and understand dollars and cents.

units.title: Time & dates
units.description: Days of the week, months, today, tomorrow and telling the time.

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Talk about getting up, going to work, eating and sleeping.

units.title: Getting around
units.description: MRT, bus and taxi: ask how to get somewhere.

units.title: Places in the city
units.description: Find the bank, hospital, school and toilet, and understand directions.

units.title: Weather
units.description: Hot, cold, rain and sun: talk about the weather.

units.title: Hobbies & free time
units.description: Say what you like to do: sports, music, films and weekends.

units.title: Work & office
units.description: Jobs, companies, meetings and being busy.

units.title: Making plans
units.description: Invite people, check if they are free and make arrangements.

units.title: Health & body
units.description: Body parts, pain, being ill, doctors and medicine.

units.title: Feelings & opinions
units.description: Say how you feel and what you think.

units.title: Home
units.description: Rooms, furniture and life in an HDB flat.

units.title: Travel & hotel
units.description: Airports, passports, hotel rooms and bookings.

units.title: Colours, clothes & describing
units.description: Colours, clothes, sizes and describing things.

units.title: Animals & nature
units.description: Cats, dogs, birds, trees, flowers and the sea.

units.title: Comparing & choosing
units.description: Compare things and choose between them.

units.title: Everyday conversations
units.description: Longer mixed dialogues that review everything.
